ov: فتاة الجمعة (الإنجليزية: His Girl Friday) فيلم كوميدي صدر عام 1940 من إخراج هاورد هوكس وبطولة روزاليند راسل وكاري غرانت. يعتبر الفيلم من كلاسيكيات الكوميديا. امتاز الفيلم بسرعة الحوار وتسارع الأحداث.
plotEn:
Sly newspaper editor Walter Burns learns that his ex-wife and former star reporter, Hildy Johnson, is about to marry insurance man Bruce Baldwin and settle down as a housewife in Albany. Determined to sabotage these plans, Walter convinces a reluctant Hildy to cover one last story: the pending execution of Earl Williams, who has been convicted of murdering a black policeman. Walter maintains that Williams is innocent and that the city fathers are only going through with the execution to curry favor with black voters. Hildy accepts the assignment on the condition that Walter buy a life insurance policy from Bruce. Wary of Walter and his pickpocket associate, Louie, she takes charge of the $500 that Bruce is carrying and instructs him to hide the insurance check in the lining of his hat.
While Hildy works on a story sympathetic to Williams (arguing that he acted on an irresistible impulse), Walter does everything he can to keep Bruce from taking her to Albany. Using Louie, he plants a watch on Bruce and has him arrested for theft, forcing Hildy to bail him out of jail. Exasperated, she quits. Williams then escapes by stealing the sheriff's gun during a botched reenactment of his crime, which triggers her journalistic instincts. Using $450 of Bruce's money, she buys the story from the warden and continues reporting.
